page.layout: One column of running text, centred under the running head "PRÆFATIO". Margin on the right holds only the edge of the facing page, which is not transcribed. No page number, catchword or signature. Hebrew and one Greek word are set inline in the text.

main_text.p: coleretur : quia noverat quam proclive esset humanum genus ad schismata, dum sibi quisque speciale ac proprium unius vel etiam diversorum Deorum (quamvis unicus tantum sit ) cultum fingeret ; tabernaculum exstrui curavit, quo ter quot-annis mares saltem convenirent, atque hac ratione unitatem religionis foverent, dum ad unicum altare sacrificia sua mactarent[?], aliaque ad mutuum fovendum consensum perficerent. Hoc itaque tabernaculum in deserto erectum , ubi in terram Canaam pervenissent, Gilgale collocarunt : ubi quatuordecim annis permansit;prout in סדר עולם רבא sive Chronico Hebræo-rum magno his docetur verbis ; י״ שנה שעשו ישראל בגלגלהן[?] שבע שכיבשו וזי שחילקו[?], quatuordecim anni quos transegerunt Israelitæ Gilgale, hi sunt septem quibus subjugarunt, & septem quibus diviserunt, scil. terram Canaan. Deinde tabernaculum transtulerunt Schiluntem : ubi, si credamus Maimonidi, בנו בית של אבניכם ופרשו יריעות[?] המשכן עליו ולא הייתה שם הקרש[?], aedificarunt domum lapideam, atque super eam aulæa tabernaculi expanderunt, deerat enim tectum. Illa auctor ר' עולי סדר[?], hoc modo paulo distinctius effert, ביתה הבחירה שבשילה היה בנוי בנין[?] של אבנים מלמטן ויריעות מלמעלן[?], domus electa, quæ erat Schilunte, inferne erat ædificata structurâ lapideâ; superne vero aulæis tegebatur. Hæc structura lapidea inde confirmari videtur, quod dicatur היכל 1 Sam.1.9. היכל[?] autem secundum Heb. hujusmodi complectatur ἅγιον[?], sanctum & sanctum sanctorum , qualia in Salomonis templo fuerunt

page.notes: Hebrew lines (סדר עולם, the lines beginning י״ שנה, שבע, בנו בית, המשכן, ביתה הבחירה, של אבנים, and the Hebrew in the Sam. reference) are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the marked words are best readings. The Greek word ἅγιον and the Latin "mactarent" are uncertain. The "ct" ligature in "mactarent" is read from context. The right edge of the image shows part of the facing page (text fragments such as "fuc", "Dei", "Dom", "7.6", "Nom", "Eli", "Gil"), which is not transcribed. The left-hand dot is a stain.
